question_patterns: why does a cactus have spikes
why is the cactus so prickly
why does a cactus have sharp needles
en.first_sentence: A cactus has spikes so it can keep its water inside.
facts: A cactus spike is really a leaf that changed shape.
Spikes stop water from leaving the cactus's body.
Spikes also keep animals from wanting to eat it.
en.ask_back: Do you think a cactus lives in a wet place, or a dry place?

bridges.has_dog: Dogs can get poked by cactus spikes. Would your dog touch one?
